professional.label: Software engineering
professional.definition: Total professional software-engineering duration; never specialty or technology tenure.

b2b.label: B2B
b2b.definition: The assigned software primarily serves business/professional workflows (e.g. corporate treasury or advisor operations). Merchants accepting consumer payments, company clients, and the recruiter's business model alone do NOT qualify.

consumer.label: Consumer product
consumer.definition: The assigned software directly serves personal activities such as shopping, borrowing or learning. Supporting merchants/institutions does not by itself turn that consumer journey into B2B.

mixed-audience.label: Mixed audience
mixed-audience.definition: Both independent business and consumer use cases are explicit and the assigned product area is unclear. Neutral unless a separate preference is defined.

internal-tools.label: Internal tools
internal-tools.definition: Software used by the employer's own teams. Not automatically an externally sold B2B product.

hr-platform.label: HR platform
hr-platform.definition: Software for HR/payroll/workforce management. Incidental HR staff, recruiting firms or the user's employer are not enough.

growth-work.label: Growth-focused work
growth-work.definition: The assigned work explicitly focuses on activation, onboarding, lifecycle, engagement, funnels or conversion growth.

developer-tools.label: Developer tools
developer-tools.definition: Software used to develop, release, secure or operate software.

marketing-tools.label: Marketing tools
marketing-tools.definition: Campaign, marketing analytics or marketing workflow software.

energy-utilities.label: Energy utilities
energy-utilities.definition: Software supporting power utilities or grid operations.

ai-platform.label: AI platform
ai-platform.definition: Software for operating/deploying AI applications or models.

ai-evaluation.label: AI evaluation
ai-evaluation.definition: Software environments that evaluate AI model behavior.

relational-db.label: Relational databases
relational-db.definition: A general relational-database requirement, not a specific vendor.

orm.label: ORM
orm.definition: A general ORM requirement permitting equivalent tools.

compiled-language.label: Compiled languages
compiled-language.definition: General compiled statically typed languages, only when equivalents are allowed.

server-side-language.label: Server-side language
server-side-language.definition: General server-side programming-language experience when the source permits equivalent languages.

modern-frontend.label: Modern frontend
modern-frontend.definition: General modern frontend frameworks, not specific React proficiency.

llm-tools.label: LLM tools
llm-tools.definition: General usage of LLM tools, not proficiency with a specific named product.

backend.label: Backend development
backend.definition: Building backend services; not a proxy for every engineering skill.

financial.label: Financial domain
financial.definition: Experience in finance, banking, payments or reconciliation; not proof of each specialty.

ai-assisted.label: AI-assisted development
ai-assisted.definition: Using AI/LLM coding tools, including a named tool OR equivalents; not building AI models.

degree.label: Relevant technical degree
degree.definition: A software/computing/engineering degree. Exact graduate degrees remain unmapped.

automated-testing.label: Automated testing
automated-testing.definition: General automated testing. Do not substitute for a required specific subtype.

api-development.label: API development
api-development.definition: Designing or implementing APIs; use REST APIs only when REST is explicit.

workflow-automation.label: Workflow automation
workflow-automation.definition: Designing or implementing automated business or operational workflows.

machine-learning.label: Machine learning
machine-learning.definition: Building, training or operating machine-learning systems.

airline-domain-experience.label: Airline domain experience
airline-domain-experience.definition: Experience with airline operations, reservations, fares or inventory.

asynchronous-workflows.label: Asynchronous workflows
asynchronous-workflows.definition: Coordinating jobs, events or work that continues beyond an initial request.

cloud-networking.label: Cloud networking
cloud-networking.definition: Cloud networks, routing, firewalls and private endpoints.

cloud-infrastructure.label: Cloud infrastructure
cloud-infrastructure.definition: Cloud compute, storage, networking and platform resources.

cloud-operations.label: Cloud operations and optimization
cloud-operations.definition: Operating cloud services and improving their reliability, capacity, performance or cost.

engineering-process.label: Engineering delivery
engineering-process.definition: General SDLC/release experience; not evidence for a specific vendor or specialty.

distributed.label: Distributed systems
distributed.definition: Distributed services and their failure/consistency characteristics.

english.label: English for daily work
english.definition: Daily work/communication in English; not a standardized CEFR score.

english-b2.label: English B2
english-b2.definition: Explicit B2 proficiency; daily English alone does not establish certification/level.

english-c1.label: English C1
english-c1.definition: Explicit C1 or higher proficiency; do not infer it.

system-design.label: System design
system-design.definition: Architecture/design knowledge; do not infer from tenure.

data-integrity.label: Transactions & integrity
data-integrity.definition: Transactions, consistency and integrity; financial domain alone does not establish it.

api-integration.label: API integrations
api-integration.definition: Integrating external APIs, webhooks or systems.

authentication.label: Authentication & authorization
authentication.definition: Identity, access control and authentication flows.

ci-cd.label: CI/CD
ci-cd.definition: Build and delivery pipelines; not any particular pipeline tool.

container-orchestration.label: Container orchestration
container-orchestration.definition: Operating container schedulers; Docker alone does not establish it.

production-operations.label: Production operations
production-operations.definition: Operating and owning live production services.

secure-coding.label: Secure coding
secure-coding.definition: Application security and secure coding practices.

cloud-native.label: Cloud-native systems
cloud-native.definition: Building/operating cloud-native applications; not every cloud vendor.

data-engineering.label: Data engineering
data-engineering.definition: Data processing/pipeline engineering; not all backend work.

data-integration.label: Data integration
data-integration.definition: Acquiring, combining and reliably synchronizing data across systems.

data-applications.label: Data applications
data-applications.definition: Applications whose user-facing value relies directly on data processing or exploration.

database-engineering.label: Database engineering
database-engineering.definition: Designing, operating and improving databases as a primary responsibility.

ai-integration.label: AI integration
ai-integration.definition: Building products integrating model APIs/outputs; not merely using coding assistants.

ai-evaluation.label: AI evaluation
ai-evaluation.definition: Benchmarks and evaluation environments for AI systems.

product-experimentation.label: Product experimentation
product-experimentation.definition: Controlled product experiments, including A/B, split, multivariate and feature experiments, plus experimentation frameworks.

analytics-instrumentation.label: Analytics instrumentation
analytics-instrumentation.definition: Planning, implementing and validating product events, properties and telemetry.

product-analytics.label: Product analytics
product-analytics.definition: Funnels, conversion, retention, cohorts and behavioral analysis.

consumer-product-development.label: Consumer product development
consumer-product-development.definition: Building or shipping software products used directly by consumers.

design-systems.label: Design systems
design-systems.definition: Shared UI components, styles, tokens and interaction patterns.

developer-platforms.label: Developer platforms
developer-platforms.definition: Internal platforms and tooling that improve engineering productivity.

energy-domain-experience.label: Energy domain experience
energy-domain-experience.definition: Experience with energy generation, utilities, grids, metering or energy markets.

finops.label: FinOps
finops.definition: Cloud cost management, accountability and optimization.

large-scale-systems.label: Large-scale systems
large-scale-systems.definition: Designing or operating systems under high traffic, large data volumes or substantial scale.

high-availability.label: High availability
high-availability.definition: Redundancy, fault tolerance and recovery that keep production services available.

recommendation-systems.label: Recommendation systems
recommendation-systems.definition: Ranking, recommending or personalizing content and products for users.

search-engineering.label: Search engineering
search-engineering.definition: Building or operating information-retrieval and search infrastructure.

self-healing-systems.label: Self-healing systems
self-healing-systems.definition: Automatically detecting failures and restoring unhealthy components.

self-service-platforms.label: Self-service platforms
self-service-platforms.definition: Platforms that let users configure, provision or activate services themselves.

software-supply-chain-security.label: Software supply-chain security
software-supply-chain-security.definition: Protecting dependencies, builds, artifacts and release pipelines.

micro-frontends.label: Micro-frontends
micro-frontends.definition: Frontend sections developed and deployed independently.

object-oriented-design.label: Object-oriented design
object-oriented-design.definition: Object-oriented programming principles and reusable design patterns.

technical-leadership.label: Technical leadership
technical-leadership.definition: Leading technical projects; not inferred from senior title alone.

team-problem-solving.label: Team problem solving
team-problem-solving.definition: Concrete experience solving technical problems in a team.

high-growth.label: High-growth teams
high-growth.definition: Experience in high-growth organizations; not a personality trait.

saas-experience.label: SaaS experience
saas-experience.definition: Experience operating a SaaS product; not a product audience classification.

aws-certification.label: AWS certification
aws-certification.definition: Explicit AWS certification; use source label for any required specialization.

code-review.label: Code review
code-review.definition: Routine review participation expected of experienced engineers.

generic-problem-solving.label: Problem solving
generic-problem-solving.definition: Generic problem solving without a measurable specialty.

generic-debugging.label: Generic debugging
generic-debugging.definition: Routine software debugging without a specialized system, incident, or diagnostic scope.

generic-communication.label: Communication
generic-communication.definition: Generic communication without a stated language level or specialized audience.

fast-paced.label: Fast-paced work
fast-paced.definition: Generic ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

adaptability.label: Adaptability
adaptability.definition: Generic adaptability or eagerness to learn.

http-json-fundamentals.label: HTTP and JSON fundamentals
http-json-fundamentals.definition: Routine HTTP, status-code and JSON knowledge expected for experienced web/backend engineers.

generic-software-testing.label: Generic software testing
generic-software-testing.definition: Routine software-testing expectations without a specific testing specialty.

technical-debt-management.label: Technical debt management
technical-debt-management.definition: Routine technical-debt responsibility without explicit specialized ownership or scope.

large-codebase-experience.label: Large codebase experience
large-codebase-experience.definition: Vague large/distributed-codebase experience without a measurable specialty.
